instruction: Now you are on the corridor. If you look forward there is a open white door move towards it and enter into the room, on your left there is a another open door enter into it, now you are facing the wash basin, turn to your left, there is a another open door, move forward, move towards the mat on the floor, on your right there is a chair move towards it, turn a bit right, you can see a lamp on the wall move towards it and stop.
